svg.title: Jing-Zhang City Completeness v0.6 Review Evidence Dashboard
svg.desc: Places core metrics, C7, three flagship pilots, implementation gates, inclusion and claim boundaries into the above-fold evidence that the Review Agent can inspect directly.
svg.text: v0.6 | Review evidence dashboard: ordinary city first, AI second
Not a self-score. It moves locatable evidence, stop rules and claim boundaries above the fold; the Review Agent / maintainer still decides the score.

7 city abilities + 3 flagship pilots + 10 scenarios
baseline / human takeover / exit
Three flagship pilots | PRECONDITION → TEST → RECEIPT → GO / REVISE / STOP
01 ZHONGZHIYUAN | low-speed robot test
Non-AI baseline: ordinary walking + staffed delivery
Gate: boundary / safety / insurance / accountable role
STOP: pedestrian intrusion, unsafe near-miss, access barrier
Currency cost, contracts and permits stay UNKNOWN until verified
02 AI ORIGIN | accessible care/navigation
Non-AI baseline: physical signs + staffed help desk
Gate: physical access / human help / data minimization
STOP: wrong route, exclusion, sensitive-data misuse
Refusing tracking/account may not remove basic service
03 DAZHONGSI | transfer + multilingual guide
Non-AI baseline: fixed wayfinding + human service
Gate: freshness / queue safety / verified real accessibility
STOP: stale info, queue harm, basic access failure
Provisional key-area geometry is not station engineering evidence
Public interest | 9 explicit user groups
long-term residents/families · older people · disabled/sensory-limited users · children/caregivers
students/researchers · founders/firms · service workers/commuters · visitors/international users
no-smartphone / no-account / deliberate opt-out users
Each checks: benefit → burden → exclusion risk → non-AI equivalent → human help / appeal
Public space remains walkable, usable and help-accessible without an account; basic service survives AI-off.
Implementation + claim boundary | directly auditable
RACI: A / R / C / I; quantity basis; maintenance cadence; start gates; stop receipts
Evidence index: brief 20% · originality 10% · AI planning 15% · feasibility 20%
inclusion 10% · risk 10% · expression 15%; one-hop mapping to agent.1–agent.6
Do not claim official boundaries, approvals, partnerships, investment, budgets, field performance or implementation.
Machine PASS proves package/evidence consistency, not statutory or field validity.
